crossRefs.note: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.
After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate…

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Of Arimathea, buried Jesus in his own tomb

translations.web: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
translations.bsb: When Pilate had confirmed it with the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
translations.kjv: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
translations.asv: And when he learned it of the centurion, he granted the corpse to Joseph.
